publicationTitle: 2009 IEEE International Symposium on IT in Medicine & Education
abstract: By analyzing the current situation of data sharing between Web applications and the different characteristics between campus network and Web, we propose two primary goals in designing a new data sharing system for campus network, which are giving the control of data back to the user and utilizing the existing infrastructure in a campus network. To accomplish these two goals, a new design of a data sharing system for campus network is presented. The three parties in this new system: consumer, data provider and certification server are defined and the interaction process among them is explained in detail. A prototype system is implemented to demonstrate our design, some limitations and existing issues of this design are also given in this paper.

articleTitle: A live multimedia system using hybrid P2P architecture for distance learning
publicationTitle: 2009 IEEE International Symposium on IT in Medicine & Education
abstract: Multimedia distance learning is an important way to realize continuing education, lifelong education and quality education. In this paper, a P2P-based live multimedia system named PPLearn is presented to provide a scalable, reliable and high available live multimedia service for distance learning. Architecturally, PPLearn is constructed based on a two-layer hybrid P2P structure. In particular, a tree like P2P structure based on application layer multicast (ALM) is designed to connect the agent gateways in the inter-domain layer, and in the intra-domain layer, agent clients can either use ALM or IP multicast to view the distance learning program. Consequently, PPLearn can achieve a high level quality of service even in large-scale multimedia distance learning systems.

articleTitle: A time-domain multi-resolution electrocardiogram transmission schema for telemedicine
publicationTitle: 2009 IEEE International Symposium on IT in Medicine & Education
abstract: Electrocardiogram (ECG) telemedicine is effective way to obtain better clinical service timely. Limited by network and clinical experience, a progressive ECG transmission schema is required. In this paper, a time-domain multi-resolution ECG transmission schema is proposed. This schema supports multi-segment, multi-sample, multi-lead and any ECG compression algorithm. It has proved that the schema has high scalability and practical for ECG telemedicine.

articleTitle: Indentifying pivot technologies in remote training
publicationTitle: 2009 IEEE International Symposium on IT in Medicine & Education
abstract: Remote training is one of the rapid growing fields in computer applications. This paper will investigate the pivot technologies in remote training, specifically for remote control or operational training. By means of working with a test platform of robot telecontrol, the pivot technologies in remote operational training are identified, which could be propagate to the general training scenario, such as remote education, e-learning, and so on. And examples and evaluations are provided in order to justify the validity of the investigation.

articleTitle: The realization of network virtual electronic laboratory
publicationTitle: 2009 IEEE International Symposium on IT in Medicine & Education
abstract: By integrating network technology, virtual instrument technology, video image network transmission and Web page fusion technology, the network virtual electronic laboratory based on B/S mode was developed. The network structure of the system consists of the Web server, virtual instrument system, the network video monitoring system, the Web database and the remote clients. The key technical problem of remote controlling of laboratory instruments was also settled. Through simply using the standard Internet browser, the long-distance clients can not only watch the real experiments operating and get the testing results within the same Web page, but also control many virtual instruments such as signal generator, digital oscilloscope, the modem and the differentiator. This paper presents the key technology in the system.

articleTitle: Recognize and analysis the healthy person's facial color diagnosis
publicationTitle: 2009 IEEE International Symposium on IT in Medicine & Education
abstract: We fetch facial digital vision information from 98 healthy persons using digital camera. With functional help of NIKON CAPTURE NX's software point U key technology, we catch black, white and neutral color control points. We correct the color differences of facial digital vision with self-improved facial functional software. According to the principle of Adaboost objective category, we improve the software. Under Traditional Chinese Medicine (TCM), facial information was cut into 5 divisions which are forehead, nose, left malar, right malar and chin. We do the CIE1976L*a*b* color quantity analysis using after we take 8 color pieces with size 5*5 from each part. The experiment result shows that there are differences of value of L*, a* and b* from different part of healthy persons face. That means there are color differences from different part of face. With the figures of L*, a* and b* from different face part, it generally follows the TCM clinic fact. This task technologically found the patients facial inspection in future.

articleTitle: Study on the code migration in mobile learning system
publicationTitle: 2009 IEEE International Symposium on IT in Medicine & Education
abstract: Both persistent connecting devices and nonpersistent connecting devices exist in the mobile learning environment, therefore the mobile agent code migration strategies based either on the all-code transmission plus mobile-code-source manner or on the needed-code transmission plus the fixed- code- source manner do not satisfy this situation in mobile computing systems in deed. in this paper, a flexible code migration strategy which integrates the all-code transmission plus mobile-code-source manner and the needed-code transmission plus fixed-code-source manner is presented. A mobile agent code conformation algorithm, a code storage structure and a code transmission procedure are also described. Tested by some experiments, it shows that the code migration strategy presented in this paper is more flexible than others, and on the other side both code conformation algorithm and the code storage structure can support the code transmission efficiently.

articleTitle: Hippocampus function modeling with neural network
publicationTitle: 2009 IEEE International Symposium on IT in Medicine & Education
abstract: The hippocampus and associative structures are the highest integrative centers in the brain and are known to play a critical role in memory function. To understand how the memory is formed, retrieved and how to reach conscious awareness requires the development of detailed models of hippocampus function and is helpful to study pathogenesis of some brain diseases relating with memory such as Alzheimer and Parkinson. In this paper, the detailed model of hippo-campus function is developed. This hippocampus functional model has a Hopfield-like neural network and is used 160 Izhikevich artificial neurons model as its spiking neurons. The simulation of this network under MATLAB platform shows that the network model can implement autoassociative and heteroassociative memory. The model is useful to understand two kinds of hippocampus memory functions.
